svg.title: Everest — mountain relief
svg.desc: Southwest face from Gokyo Ri. West ridge, summit pyramid, rock bands, southwest-face gullies and the Nuptse foreground. Layered vector contour adaptation of a photograph by Rdevany. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Mt._Everest_from_Gokyo_Ri_November_5,_2012.jpg. License: CC BY-SA 3.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0. Changes: sky removed, cropped, tonal contours traced, blue and white palette.
